To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) exposure to a short underdog narrative video clip increased feelings of hopefulness and subsequent goal-directed motivation relative to a control condition; 2) this effect was durable, with feelings of hopefulness remaining elevated up to 3 days following media exposure; and 3) this effect was not observed for other positive emotions, such as happiness or pride, or negative emotions, such as sadness or anxiety.
Underdog narratives, which depict characters struggling to meet goals despite unfavorable odds, evoke the positive emotion of hope, which in turn motivates goal pursuit.
